_status: Try it 1.2A: item wording from the deck slide, answers from the learner guide (19 October 2026), in the same order.

categories.label: Not covered
categories.hint: N: or not personal at all

items.text: An applicant's full name and home address
A medical certificate for medical assistance
Ben's name and job title on the citizen's charter
items.why: Information about a government employee's position (Sec. 4(a)).

items.text: An applicant's age and marital status
items.why: Age and marital status are on the sensitive list.

items.text: An applicant's mobile and e-wallet numbers
items.why: Not on the sensitive list, but an e-wallet number can be used for fraud, so treat it as high risk in the 3S test.

items.text: "1,240 applicants this quarter, by province", no names
items.why: Not personal information if no one can be identified from the totals. Be careful with very small counts, which can point to one person.
